hero_kpi_rationale: Key driver of company growth, with high margins (75.4%) and increased predictability. Services show sustained growth of 14% and now represent 26% of total revenue

kpis.name: Services Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from services such as the App Store, Apple Music, Apple TV+, iCloud, AppleCare, etc.
kpis.description: Apple's services continue to grow, with a high margin of 75.4% and increased predictability, driven by advertising, the App Store, and cloud services.

kpis.name: iPhone Revenue
kpis.description: The iPhone market shows moderate growth of 4%, driven primarily by Pro models.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin of the company
kpis.description: Apple's gross margin improves to 46.9%, thanks to a better services mix (75.4% margin) offsetting pressure on products (36.8%).

kpis.name: R&D
kpis.description: Apple is investing heavily in R&D (10% growth) to remain at the forefront of innovation, primarily through increases in personnel and infrastructure.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Apple reports 6% revenue growth, driven by services (+14%), iPhone (+4%), and Mac (+12%).

kpis.name: Greater China Revenue
kpis.description: The Chinese market continues to decline (-4%), primarily due to lower iPhone sales, partially offset by Mac growth.

kpis.name: Mac Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from Mac sales (laptops and desktops)
kpis.description: The Mac experiences remarkable growth of 12%, driven by laptops and desktops, with successful launches of MacBook Pro, Mac mini, iMac, and Mac Studio.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale. Indicateur clé pour les investisseurs orientés revenus.
kpis.description: 5-year history of declared dividends per share (2021-2025).

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel du cash redistribué aux actionnaires : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury stock).
kpis.description: For 2025: cumulative dividends + share buybacks in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée en dividendes. Au-dessus de 80 % indique un dividende potentiellement non-soutenable.
kpis.description: Dividends / net income for 2025 (based on net income attributable to shareholders).

risks.title: Geopolitical tensions and trade wars
risks.score_rationale: The risk is positioned at the beginning of the Macroeconomic and Industry Risks section, with strong language on uncertainty, potential escalation, and direct impact on supply chain and tariffs. The text mentions measures announced as early as Q2 2025 and sector-specific investigations (e.g., semiconductors), reinforcing its immediacy and severity. The Geopolitical category carries high weight given the context of Asian concentration.

risks.title: Dependence on the Asian supply chain
risks.score_rationale: The document emphasizes that the majority of manufacturing occurs in Asia (China, Vietnam, Taiwan, etc.) through outsourced partners. Geographic concentration is explicitly linked to major risks in case of disruption. The language stresses the difficulty of rapid substitution, and the risk is exacerbated by single sources. Central placement in the 10-K, with high intensity.

risks.title: Aggressive competition in technology markets
risks.score_rationale: The risk is described as structural, with pressure on margins, product imitation, and low pricing. Apple acknowledges a minority market share in several key segments. The language is repetitive and emphasizes constant threat, although the risk is stable compared to the prior year. The Competition category carries medium to high weight.

risks.title: Disruptions from global economic conditions
risks.score_rationale: The risk is extensively discussed, with mention of recession, inflation, interest rates, and consumer confidence. It is directly tied to demand for Apple's products, often considered premium. The text cites impacts on customers, suppliers, and liquidity. Strong language and early positioning in the document. High Macro weighting.

risks.title: Cyberattacks and digital security risks
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in the context of business interruptions (e.g., ransomware). Although less developed than others, it is associated with direct threats to services and infrastructure. The language is preventive but serious. The Cybersecurity category is critical for a technology company. Secondary but implicit across multiple threats.

risks.title: Dependence on single or limited suppliers
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly mentions reliance on single sources for critical components. A single supplier disruption could lead to major consequences, amplified by supply chain complexity. Strong language on potential impact ('exacerbate any negative consequences'). Existential risk in case of major failure. Industrial category highly weighted here.

risks.title: Innovation and accelerated renewal cycles
risks.score_rationale: The risk is central in the Business Risks section, with strong emphasis on the need for continuous innovation. Launch or transition failures could significantly impact revenue. The text mentions technical, production, and market acceptance challenges. Although recurring, the intensity of language and competitive pressure justify high severity.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies was found in Apple's 10-K filing for fiscal year 2025.
